violation_type.title: Responsibilities - Provides access to all areas of the operation (26 TAC §745.8411(b)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Responsibilities - Provides access to all areas of the operation
violation_type.typical_finding: I was not able to gain access to a bedroom during inspection upon arrival. I arrived at 10:46 and did not get access to the room as it was locked until 11:16.
